job.question: In the Los Angeles City Employees' Retirement System (LACERS) actuarial RFP, how many years of experience must the lead actuary have?
job.expected_facts: At least 15 years of experience with major public employee retirement systems, including at least 3 years with California public pension fund clients similar to LACERS.
job.acceptance: Accept 15 total and three California years. Do not require credential details unrelated to the years asked.

reviews.reason: This is Hawaii ERS’s 2022 real-assets investment consultant RFP, not the LACERS actuarial RFP. Its experience requirement concerns a primary investment consultant, not a lead actuary, and it does not establish the requested LACERS experience requirements.
quotes: Employees’ Retirement System of the State of Hawaii (ERS) Request for Proposals Real Assets Investment Consultant RFP 2022-06 Issued October 3, 2022
The primary consultant assigned to the ERS account shall have a minimum of seven (7) years experience providing domestic and international real assets consulting services to public pension plans.
